section: Iterate — bug: control-grade ratchet delta wording
title: Ratchet delta wording follows the sign
context: The maintainability detail always said '(net growth)', so a -509 line delta read as growth.
decision: Render net shrink for a negative delta, no change for zero, net growth for positive; score and anchor untouched.
consequences: Dashboard text matches the number; three tests pin all signs.
